propositions: Pydantic AI 1.107 emits PydanticAIDeprecationWarning when infer_model constructs openai: targets because v2 will reinterpret the prefix from Chat Completions to Responses.
rebar currently uses ambiguous openai: prefix in anthropic_model.py and model_classes.py for inferred and explicit OpenAI targets, which silently changes wire contract on pydantic-ai v2 upgrade.

Custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint routing depends on ProviderSession gates matching the openai provider name in cfg.base_url builder registration and per-candidate endpoint-override guard; changing the target prefix alone would regress endpoint injection.

Normalizing all rebar-composed and legacy openai: targets to explicit openai-chat: qualifier across primary, model-class, and fallback resolution seams preserves Chat Completions semantics and eliminates the v2 deprecation warning.
ProviderSession must recognize openai-chat: in addition to the legacy openai: alias to preserve custom-endpoint profile override and endpoint routing behavior.
